2607.13239.title: Cost-Optimal Foundation Model Deployment Portfolio for Transportation Management
2607.13239.paper_summary: Foundation models, including large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), are increasingly used for transportation management center (TMC) tasks such as anomaly detection, incident reporting, and traveler information. Deploying multiple such models across TMC functions raises a portfolio question: which model should serve each function, in which deployment mode, and under what shared hardware budget? We formulate this as the Foundation Model Deployment Portfolio (FMDP) problem, a mixed-integer program minimizing total cost of ownership (TCO) subject to per-function quality, latency, and safety constraints over shared GPU capacity. We prove the problem NP-hard by reduction from the 0-1 knapsack problem and propose a polynomial-time greedy heuristic. In an illustrative case study with five TMC functions and 19 candidate (model, mode) pairs, FMDP identifies a mixed portfolio costing $34/mo (97% below the cheapest feasible all-closed-API baseline) by routing four functions to open-source APIs and the one function whose quality floor no open-source model meets to a closed API. Break-even analysis shows that on-premise GPU investment becomes reasonable only above approximately 309 vision queries/hour or if API prices double.
2607.13239.paper_summary_zh: 基礎模型，包括大型語言模型（LLMs）和視覺語言模型（VLMs），在交通管理中心（TMC）任務中越來越多地被用於異常檢測、事件報告和旅客資訊。 在TMC功能中部署多個這樣的模型提出了一個投資組合問題：每個功能應該使用哪個模型，以何種部署模式，以及在什麼共享硬體預算下？ 我們將此問題表述為基礎模型部署投資組合（FMDP）問題，這是一個混合整數規劃問題，旨在最小化總擁有成本（TCO），同時滿足每個功能的質量、延遲和安全約束，並考慮共享的GPU容量。 我們通過從0-1背包問題的歸約證明了該問題是NP困難的，並提出了一種多項式時間的貪婪啟發式方法。 在一個包含五個TMC功能和19個候選（模型，模式）對的示範案例研究中，FMDP確定了一個混合投資組合，成本為每月34美元（比最便宜的可行全封閉API基線低97%），通過將四個功能路由到開源API，而將質量底線沒有任何開源模型滿足的那一個功能路由到封閉API。 損益平衡分析顯示，只有在每小時約309個視覺查詢以上，或者API價格翻倍的情況下，本地GPU投資才變得合理。
